preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the dividend token (CAKE or DOGE) to transfer to the dividend tracker contract
The dividend tracker contracts (CakeDividendTracker and DogeDividendTracker) must have been deployed and be operational

exploit_hint: The exploit leverages the public `distributeDividends(uint256 amount)` function in the DividendPayingToken contract. First, approve the dividend tracker contracts to spend your dividend tokens. Then call `distributeDividends()` with a small amount on either CakeDividendTracker or DogeDividendTracker contract. This will artificially inflate the `magnifiedDividendPerShare` and `totalDividendsDistributed`. Finally, call the `claim()` function on the main DogeCake contract to withdraw dividends based on the manipulated share price, receiving more dividend tokens than you deposited.
